The words the multiplayer filter (Net.filter_words, scripts/util/word_filter.gd) blanks out of ship names and chat when the host turns it on. Lowercase letters only; text is matched after lowercasing and reading 0 1 3 4 5 7 8 @ $ as o i e a s t b a s, with other characters inside a word ignored (f.u.c.k) and spaced-out single letters read as one word (f u c k). parts are blocked anywhere inside a word, any letter doubled or more (fuuuck); words only as a whole word, or with s, es, ed, er, ers, ing or y on the end (so class, cocktail, grape and Fukuoka are fine). allow lists whole words never blocked.
